depiction.primary_object: rectangular speech bubble containing three horizontal text lines
modifiers: three horizontal lines inside (bottom line shorter)

readings.meaning: text message, SMS, or chat message

ambiguity: Essentially interchangeable with the centered-pointer and right-pointer three-line speech bubbles; also easily confused at a glance with the left-tailed bulleted-list bubble.

modifier_semantics.meaning: written text content, comment body, or message transcript

task_intents: follow up with someone via text

reasoning: A square speech bubble with lines of text universally represents a text message, chat, or written comment. It is a top-tier match for everyday tasks like texting people back, replying in Slack/WhatsApp, or leaving reviews, though it closely resembles other speech-bubble icons in most sets.

readings.meaning: text message, SMS, or chat message

pass1.ambiguity: Very similar to other speech bubble variants (rounded bubble, bubble with dots, two overlapping bubbles), making it hard to distinguish between SMS, live chat, and comments.

distinguishing: Has the speech tail flushing down from the bottom-left corner and three left-aligned lines inside (the bottom one shorter), making it the standard incoming text/comment bubble and nearly interchangeable with the centered-tail and right-tail text bubbles.
